[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Rame Cartroll''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as the second-in-command of a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Unidentified Separatist CR90 corvette|CR90 corvette]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Cartroll's [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] was [[Mission to the Ando system|bombarded]] by [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] of the Confederacy's rival government, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Cartroll was subsequently captured aboard the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the stricken [[Warship/Legends|warship]] by [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] working for the Republic.

==Biography==
Rame Cartroll was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served in the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|naval forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a tumultuous conflict between the Confederacy and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Cartroll attained the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] and acted as the second-in-command of a [[Unidentified Separatist CR90 corvette|Separatist CR90 corvette]].<ref name="DA" /> Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="20 BBY">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and the adventure ''[[Night Eyes: Night's Homecoming|Night's Homecoming]]'' established that by Year 4 of the campaign over a year had elapsed since the events of ''Philology'', ''[[Decision: Almas]]'' can therefore be dated to circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> Cartroll accompanied the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] on a posting to the [[Ando system/Legends|Ando system]]<ref name="DA" /> in the [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda sector]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> where the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] hosted a Confederate diplomatic meeting involving the Human [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrel]] [[Gura Tran]] and the [[Tarasin]] [[Sheel]], representatives of the [[Thaereian military]] [[Army/Legends|armed force]] and the [[Wyrd]] [[Witch/Legends|witch]] [[Coven/Legends|coven]] respectively. Cartroll knew little of the purpose of the [[Envoy/Legends|envoys']] visit however and he was unfamiliar with with Sheel's [[Species/Legends|species]], noting her appearance to be [[Lizard/Legends|lizard-like]].<ref name="DA" />

Following the [[Mission to the Ando system|arrival]] of a Republic task force in the Ando [[Star system/Legends|system]], Cartroll's corvette was [[Space warfare/Legends|bombarded]] by Republic [[Warship/Legends|warships]] and severely crippled. Cartroll was wounded in the attack and was one of only three [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings aboard the ship to survive the Republic assault. Cartroll took shelter aboard the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the stricken vessel, where he sealed the bridge doors and brought online an emergency [[Battery/Legends|battery]] power supply.<ref name="DA" />

{{RPG|''[[Decision: Almas]]''}}
A group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance]] agents accompanying the Republic task force boarded the floundering [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] on an intelligence-gathering mission and headed to the bridge. Cartroll initially refused to allow the operatives entry onto the bridge and kept the door barred shut. After the agents promised that Cartroll would be treated well as a [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] of Republic, he relented and opened the bridge door to surrender himself. Shortly thereafter, the corvette came under fire from a [[Thaereian]] military [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] under orders to destroy evidence of the Thaereian envoy Gura Tran's meeting with the Confederates. Cartroll assisted the freelance agents in opposing the assault and he operated a [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] to fire on the starfighter.<ref name="DA" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Cartroll supported the ideals of the Confederacy of Independent Systems and believed the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], the governing body of the Republic, to be corrupt. His experiences during the Clone Wars left him weary and disillusioned, while also toughening his resolve. After the corvette that he served aboard was crippled in the Ando system, Cartroll was unhappy with the prospect of surrendering to the Republic but was uncertain about what to do to survive and was keen to survive his predicament. He was familiar with the operation of [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] turbolasers.<ref name="DA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Unfamiliar lizard-lady? Like her. ''"<br />"''Yes. Some sort of frill and her skin kept changing color.|One of the ''Decision: Almas'' player characters and Rame Cartroll, comparing one of the player characters to the Tarasin Wyrd envoy Sheel|<ref name="DA" />}}
Rame Cartroll was created by [[Ronald A. Heintz]] and appeared in ''[[Decision: Almas]]'', a [[2004]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] module that formed part of the [[Decisions trilogy]] of [[RPGA]]'s [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] roleplaying campaign.<ref name="DA" />

In ''Decision: Almas'', the player characters roleplay as the freelance agents that Cartroll encounters aboard the damaged Confederate vessel and the players can interact with him in a number of ways. The players can persuade Cartroll to open the bridge door and hand himself into their custody with assurances that he will receive good treatment as a prisoner of war. The players can alternatively bypass the door lock to access the bridge, in which case Cartroll stands behind a [[Computer/Legends|console]] with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] in hand, ready to fire on them. It is the possible for a firefight to break out between Cartroll and the freelance operatives in which the Confederate [[Officer/Legends|officer]] can [[Death/Legends|loose his life]], though the adventure encourages that the players should [[Stun/Legends|stun]] rather than kill him. If Cartroll is captured, it is possible for him to be questioned and that he discloses to the players the presence of the Thaereian and Wyrd envoys aboard the vessel, specifically comparing the appearance of Sheel to any Tarasin player characters. If Cartroll is taken as a willing prisoner, it is also possible that he fires the ships' turbolasers after the corvette falls under attack from a Thaereian military starfighter.<ref name="DA" />
